submission.justification: Based on systematic simulation studies across all three candidate materials, Absorber-F3 with 5.9 mm plate thickness achieves the best energy resolution of 3.046% at 100 GeV. This represents a significant improvement over Absorber-F2 (best: 3.886% at 4.5mm) and Absorber-F1 (best: 5.1% at 5mm). The recommendation was reached through: (1) Initial scans at 3mm, 5mm, and 8mm identifying F3 as the best-performing material, (2) Refinement scans around the F3 minimum in 0.5mm steps, then (3) Fine-tuning in 0.1-0.2mm steps to locate the optimal thickness at 5.9mm. The F3 material meets all project constraints including compatibility with hands-on maintenance during shutdowns and falls well within the specified 2-10mm thickness range.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F3 at 5.9mm delivers 3.046% resolution, which is the best result among all 24 simulations performed across three materials and multiple thicknesses
